title: Why the Number 4 Is AVOIDED Everywhere in Asia
description: Missing floor buttons, no room 4, phone numbers without it. The number 4 is basically ghosted across Asia. What's an unlucky number where YOU live?

sections.narration: Imagine you're in an elevator in Asia and you notice the button for floor four is missing.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy in elevator, panel showing 1-2-3-5, warm metallic tones

sections.narration: Like, it just skips from three straight to five, no explanation.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy pointing at elevator buttons, confused face, warm lighting

sections.narration: And then you realize floors fourteen, twenty-four, and forty are gone too.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy counting on fingers, elevator panel with gaps, warm tones

sections.narration: So basically, in Chinese, Japanese, and Korean, the word 'four' sounds like 'death.'
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy with speech bubble showing the number 4, warm background

sections.narration: It's so serious that hospitals often skip room four entirely for patient comfort.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy in hospital hallway, doors numbered 3 then 5, soft light

sections.narration: And it gets weirder — some people avoid phone numbers or license plates with fours.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy looking at phone number crossed out, car plate, warm scene

sections.narration: But here's the thing — the number eight is the total opposite, it means wealth.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy holding big number 8, golden sparkles, warm background

sections.narration: People actually pay extra money for phone numbers loaded with eights.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy on phone showing 8888 number, happy expression, warm room

sections.narration: So THAT'S why buildings skip floors and prices end in eight instead of four.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy next to building with floor numbers, 8 highlighted gold

sections.narration: It's not just superstition — it literally shapes how cities are designed.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy overlooking city skyline, building numbers visible, warm dusk

sections.narration: Next time you spot a missing floor four, you'll know exactly what's going on.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy smiling knowingly in elevator, warm golden light
Centered: boy giving thumbs up, warm earth-toned background, simple
